title: Why TypeScript is eating JavaScript alive in 2026

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: JavaScript’s got a problem — and it’s growing fast.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: TypeScript is now used in 82% of large-scale frontend apps.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s JavaScript with built-in error checking and type safety.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Its biggest feature? Optional types that catch bugs before runtime.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Every major framework now supports it — React, Angular, Vue.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: You’re not just writing code — you’re writing safer, smarter code.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ready to join the 2 million devs who switched to TypeScript?

caption_text: Why TypeScript is eating JavaScript alive in 2026
